requirement.statement: The Schema Editor SHALL provide an explicitly selected structured-value modal with vanilla-jsoneditor Visual and Monaco JSON modes sharing one local draft, and SHALL emit exactly one normalized value change only when the user applies a valid draft.

case.when: The user edits Visual and switches to JSON, or enters valid JSON and switches to Visual.
case.then: Both modes SHALL project the same local draft without emitting a host command.

case.given: The Monaco text is invalid JSON.
case.when: The user switches to Visual or applies.
case.then: The presenter SHALL preserve the text, remain in JSON, expose a diagnostic, and emit no command.

case.given: The draft is serializable and satisfies rootKind.
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit exactly one value change and leave acceptance to the host/domain writer through ValueHost feedback.

case.given: The local draft differs from accepted value.
case.then: The presenter SHALL discard the draft and emit no command.

requirement.statement: The presenter SHALL be referenced only by stable id and serializable options, SHALL load its directly declared engines lazily, and SHALL fail closed without an implicit raw-text fallback.

case.given: A structure has no explicit structured-value presentation.
case.then: It SHALL retain the structural presenter or diagnostic and SHALL NOT select the modal implicitly.

case.given: An editor engine cannot load or presenter options are illegal.
case.then: The presenter SHALL expose an actionable diagnostic, disable Apply, and SHALL NOT fall back to textarea.

case.given: The Element Plus package is consumed without Workbench.
case.then: They SHALL resolve from direct package dependencies and contract/logic/support/Vue SHALL remain engine-free.
